summary: The root قمع (qmE) refers to the base or stalk of a date, the part that sticks to it. It can also describe the meatus of the ear. The term highlights small, foundational, or attached parts.
lane: قَمِعُ البُسْرِ ذ What sticks to the date, around its stalk: (Mgh:) the base of the date. (Mgh, art. ذنب .) See ثُفْرُوقٌ . -b2- See also a use of the pl. أَقْمَاع , voce دَرْدَار . -b3- قِمَعُ الأُذُونِ The meatus of the ear: see جُلْجُلاَنٌ .
